Executive Advisory Network

Curated Opportunities for Elite Talent

The Predictive Engine built this Advisory Network to bridge the gap between top-tier independent professionals and the world's most innovative companies. Here, you will find thousands of highly vetted, premium-compensation opportunities across executive consulting, AI engineering, financial operations, and specialized scientific fields. By aggregating the premier expert networks and AI talent platforms in one place, we make it easier for you to discover the right roles and monetize your expertise on your own terms.

About Our Partner Networks

GLG (Gerson Lehrman Group) Est. 1998

GLG is the world's largest and most prestigious expert network, acting as the primary B2B research engine in the market. It connects executive-level professionals with decision-makers at investment funds, private equity firms, and Fortune 500 companies.

Relevance: The gold standard in market intelligence. Participating as a GLG consultant not only offers high hourly compensation but also positions your profile directly in front of the world's largest financial entities.

Micro1 AI Talent Network

Micro1 is a global talent and recruiting platform backed and driven by Artificial Intelligence. Its model uses synthetic interviews and validation algorithms to evaluate and recruit the "Top 1%" of technical and strategic talent in the market, placing them in key projects for global companies.

Relevance: Redefines B2B recruiting agility. Hosting high-impact roles ranging from Infrastructure Engineering to Executive Consulting, it is one of the main gateways for enterprise-grade remote operations.

Ethos AI Foundation Model Evaluation

Ethos AI is a highly specialized network focused on creating high-quality datasets for Artificial Intelligence training (RLHF). Instead of repetitive tasks, Ethos exclusively recruits Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) with high-level certifications, advanced degrees, or executive experience to evaluate the reasoning and technical accuracy of Large Language Models (LLMs).

Relevance: Essential for algorithmic safety and accuracy. Consultants at Ethos audit AI performance on critical tasks such as macroeconomic analysis, M&A operations, and advanced code architecture.

SuperAnnotate Est. 2018

SuperAnnotate is the world's leading data training platform for AI and automation. Backed by major private equity firms and used by frontier AI labs, it provides the essential Quality Assurance (QA) and complex annotation infrastructure needed to optimize the performance of computer vision and generative models.

Relevance: The backbone of LLM training. Its Quality Assurance Leads (QA Leads) guide the teams responsible for ensuring that the output of artificial intelligences is semantically and technically flawless.

AfterQuery Asynchronous Intelligence

AfterQuery is an emerging expert network focused on connecting specialized knowledge through data evaluations, market validation projects, and asynchronous analytical requirements for consultancies and technology developers.

Relevance: Provides an agile flow of qualitative data. It allows professionals in legal, quantitative, and research fields to monetize their expertise without the need for lengthy synchronous meetings.
AI interview is mandatory for most roles — profiles will not move forward without it. Complete your AI interview as soon as possible. Roles are filling quickly and profiles are reviewed on a rolling basis. Completing your application early significantly increases your chances of selection.
